table.name: TLGNC_TP_SAP_VENDOR
table.description: Table storing 3rd Party SAP Vendors. An entry represents an SAP Partner and a role it can fulfill in an order (delivery). An SAP Partner can appear in multiple roles.

column.name: TP_SAP_VENDOR_ID
column.description: PK. Id of the SAP Vendor appearing in a certain role (partner function).

column.name: SAP_TP_SAP_VENDOR_PF_CD
column.description: FK. Reference to the partner function.

column.name: SAP_VENDOR_ID
column.description: FK. Reference to the SAP Vendor.

column.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
column.description: Active flag of the 3rd Party SAP Vendor. Active = 1, Inactive = 0
